extracted.intended_audience: researchers in compressed sensing / statistics theory / optimization
extracted.subtask_description: Analysis of the Modified Basis Pursuit (ℓ1-minimization over T^c) for signal recovery when part of the support is known or guessed; proving exact recovery conditions under Restricted Isometry Property assumptions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Modified Basis Pursuit method (Vaswani and Lu)
rubrics_metrics.description: The Modified Basis Pursuit method consists of minimizing the ℓ1 norm of the estimate over the indices indexed by T^c only.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: T is an initial (possibly erroneous) guess of the signal support; the algorithm ignores indices in T when minimizing the ℓ1 norm, focusing sparsity penalization on T^c.

rubrics_metrics.name: Problem setting: underdetermined linear system
rubrics_metrics.description: Recover a signal x ∈ ℝ^p using an observation vector y = A x, where A ∈ ℝ^{n×p} and in the highly underdetermined setting n ≪ p.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The analysis and guarantees are given for the standard compressed sensing regime with far fewer measurements than signal dimension; methods and assumptions should be appropriate to this regime.

rubrics_metrics.name: Partially known support and initial guess T
rubrics_metrics.description: The approach is based on an initial and possibly erroneous guess T of the signal's support supp(x).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The effectiveness of the method and the recovery guarantees depend on the relationship between T and the true support, in particular the number of missed components (T^c ∩ supp(x)).

rubrics_metrics.name: Exact recovery condition via Restricted Isometry Property (RIP)
rubrics_metrics.description: Exact recovery is proved essentially under a Restricted Isometry Property assumption of order 2 times the cardinal of T^c ∩ supp(x) (i.e., the number of missed components).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The RIP order required scales with twice the number of missed support elements; establishing such an RIP for the measurement matrix A is central to the recovery guarantee.

rubrics_metrics.name: Proof correctness and publication status
rubrics_metrics.description: Comments: Withdrawn due to an error in the proof. A new version will be submitted as a section in a future paper.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: A valid contribution requires a correct proof of the stated claims; withdrawn status indicates the presented proof contained a substantive error and must be corrected before relying on the result.
